Aiwork is the AI workspace for investors and businesses, available across web and mobile. It brings together specialized AI professionals for investment research, market intelligence, accounting, HR, and report generation within one connected workspace.

Each Aiwork app is purpose-built around a defined professional function, combining specialized intelligence with structured workflows and practical outputs.

With Aiwork, you can access:

Orion Insights — Equity research, company analysis, and thematic insights covering thousands of global stocks

Hermes X — Real-time market intelligence, event-driven alerts, and signals delivered directly to your devices

Luca Accounts — AI-powered accounting assistance for recording transactions, managing financial data, and supporting everyday finance workflows

Freddie HR — Recruitment and workforce management, from candidate processing and onboarding to employee records and HR workflows

Saras Reports — AI-powered creation of professional reports, presentations, and business documents using structured templates or flexible instructions

Aiwork is built for investors, founders, businesses, and professional teams that need more than a general-purpose chatbot. Its specialized AI professionals are designed to understand specific areas of work, follow structured processes, and produce consistent, execution-ready results.

Use Aiwork to research companies, monitor financial markets, manage accounting entries, run recruitment and HR processes, and generate professional reports from anywhere.

One workspace. Multiple AI professionals. Built for real work.

Bossjob revolutionizes the job search experience by enabling instant communication between job seekers and employers. With cutting-edge AI technology and direct chat features, Bossjob simplifies your journey to career success. Whether you're searching for the perfect job or looking to hire top talent, Bossjob makes the process seamless, efficient, and impactful.

Why use Bossjob? 

- AI-Driven Hiring Solutions: From smart job recommendations to AI-powered resume creation, Bossjob transforms how job seekers and employers connect.
- Real-Time Communication: Chat directly with employers to save time, simplify the hiring process, and enhance your job search experience.
- Exclusive Opportunities: Complete access to remote and local jobs in the Philippines with trusted employers actively hiring now.

Main features:

- AI-Powered Job Matching : Receive personalized job recommendations tailored to your skills, preferences, and career goals in just minutes.
- Chat Directly with employers: Skip the traditional email chains and connect instantly with hiring managers to discuss job details, interview schedules, and offers.
- Smart Resume Builder : Leverage Bossjob's AI Resume Builder and Analysis to create or optimize your resume, boosting your chances of landing interviews.

record.name: Offerheap: IT Recruitment
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Welcome to Offerheap - the platform for IT recruitment that brings together companies, specialists and EdTech players. Confirm your skills, find desired vacancies and connect with companies and recruiters. 

Offerheap will assist you in assessing your skills and recommend you to companies that are a good fit for you. Our algorithm will find suitable job opportunities based on your skills and experience. And you have full control over sharing your contact details only with those you deem necessary.

Key Benefits:

• Automatic Job Matching: our AI will match you with suitable job positions based on your skills and experience, so you can find the right job quickly and easily.
• Faster time-to-hire: find your desired job faster thanks to our algorithms. Employers can quickly see your potential and invite you for an interview, saving you time and effort.
• Smart Rating System: our smart rating system takes the guesswork out of the hiring process by taking into account data on all users of the platform.
• Keep Privacy: you’ll keep your contact information and data private until you receive an interesting invitation and decide to respond to it.
• Community of like-minded people: Offerheap is designed to bring together people who share passion for technologies, creating a supportive and collaborative community where you can connect with others who have similar interests and goals.

The Offerheap app is free to use and download.

---------------

record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Lootra is your all-in-one platform for mastering AI tools — no jargon, no overwhelm. Whether you're a professional, developer, student, creator, or founder, Lootra breaks down the most powerful AI tools into bite-sized, hands-on courses you can finish in minutes.

LEARN THE TOOLS THAT MATTER
Courses covering ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Midjourney, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ElevenLabs, Runway, Suno, and many more — organized by what you actually want to do.

INTERACTIVE, NOT PASSIVE
Each course combines theory, quizzes, flashcards, fill-in-the-blank exercises, sorting challenges, and AI-evaluated tasks so you learn by doing — not just reading.

BUILT-IN AI CHAT
Practice what you learn instantly. Chat with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Perplexity, and Mistral — all within the app. Switch between providers and models without juggling separate accounts.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT LIBRARY
Stop guessing what to type. Browse expert-crafted prompts for productivity, coding, writing, marketing, creative work, business, and research — then copy and use them immediately.

COURSES FOR EVERY GOAL
• AI Tools — hands-on training for specific tools
• Fundamentals — how AI actually works
• Business — strategy, automation, and growth
• Creative — images, video, music, and writing
• AI Coding — Copilot, Cursor, and code generation
• Career — job search, interviews, and growth
• Marketing — social media, SEO, ads, and content
• Making Money — side hustles, freelancing, and income

EARN CERTIFICATES
Complete courses and earn certificates to showcase your AI skills.

DESIGNED FOR BUSY PEOPLE
Set a daily learning goal — 5, 15, or 30+ minutes — and build AI skills at your own pace. Pick up right where you left off.

PRO FEATURES
• All courses and certifications unlocked
• All AI models unlocked
• 20x more AI usage
• Priority access to new features

Available in 9 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, and Turkish.

Start free. Learn fast. Ride the wave of AI.

Privacy Policy: https://lootra.ai/privacy
